title: Разговор о фестивалях и традициях
description: Проиграй по ролям интервью о праздниках и фестивалях в твоей стране: карнавалы, костюмы, фейерверки и суеверия. Реплики появляются на экране по очереди.

dialogue.speaker: student a
dialogue.text: Hi! I'd like to ask you some questions about festivals in your country.

dialogue.speaker: student b
dialogue.text: Sure! I'll be happy to answer.

dialogue.speaker: student a
dialogue.text: What are the most popular festivals in your country?

dialogue.speaker: student b
dialogue.text: We have many popular festivals, but New Year and Victory Day are very important. People also enjoy local carnivals and city celebrations.

dialogue.speaker: student a
dialogue.text: Do people wear special clothes at festivals?

dialogue.speaker: student b
dialogue.text: Yes, they do. At some festivals people wear traditional clothes or costumes.

dialogue.speaker: student a
dialogue.text: What do people usually do at a carnival?

dialogue.speaker: student b
dialogue.text: They watch parades, listen to music, dance and take photos. It is always very exciting.

dialogue.speaker: student a
dialogue.text: Do families usually celebrate together?

dialogue.speaker: student b
dialogue.text: Yes, they usually do. Families often have a special meal and spend time together.

dialogue.speaker: student a
dialogue.text: Are fireworks common at celebrations in your country?

dialogue.speaker: student b
dialogue.text: Yes, they are. Fireworks are very popular on big holidays.

dialogue.speaker: student a
dialogue.text: Do people believe in any superstitions connected with holidays?

dialogue.speaker: student b
dialogue.text: Some people do. They carry lucky coins or charms before exams and important days.

dialogue.speaker: student a
dialogue.text: What festival from another country would you like to visit?

dialogue.speaker: student b
dialogue.text: I'd like to visit Carnival in Brazil, because it looks colourful and fun.

dialogue.speaker: student a
dialogue.text: Why do you think festivals are important?

dialogue.speaker: student b
dialogue.text: I think they bring people together and help us learn about traditions.

dialogue.speaker: student a
dialogue.text: That's interesting. Thank you for your answers!

dialogue.speaker: student b
dialogue.text: You're welcome. It was nice to talk to you.
